Baked Beets with Anise
By: Barnaby Dorfman
Published: Wednesday, February 10, 2010 - 10:25pm

Ingredients




1 bunch beets and greens
2 wholes star anise

Preparation

1 Take baby beets and cut off the leaves, save aside. Wrap the beets all together in tinfoil. Include a couple of pieces of star anise. Bake at 350 degrees until tender, about 45 min to 1 hour. Remove from oven and when cool, slip off skins. Steam beet greens and reheat beets in just a smidgen of butter. 2 Serve beets on top of greens.

About


A simple and delicious preparation.
